name: Mystic Disarmament
body:
School transmutation; Level inquisitor 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area 10-foot radius burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Weapons held by creatures within the burst are wrenched from their grasp and dropped to the ground.

An affected creature can make a Reflex save to negate this effect.
